title: useLocalStorage Hook
description:
Implement a `useLocalStorage<T>` hook that works like `useState` but persists the value to `localStorage` under the given key.

**Signature:**
```ts
function useLocalStorage<T>(key: string, initialValue: T): [T, (value: T) => void]
```
ai_context: Tests useState lazy initializer and localStorage API. Common mistakes: not JSON.parse/stringify, not using lazy initializer causing hydration issues.
